newsitem.title: USA: Chile's Endesa files $580 mln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Endesa files $580 mln shelf debt.

text.p: Chile's Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA (Endesa) on Wednesday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $580 million in debt securities.

The offering will be made in three series of notes, it said. Proceeds from the first will be used to finance a portion of the company's capital expenditure program in Chile. Money raised from the second will be used outside Chile while proceeds from the third will be used to refinance debt owed to a bank syndicate led by Chase Manhattan Bank, a unit of Chase Manhattan Corp.
The offering will be made through Chase Securities Inc, Credit Suisse First Boston and J.P. Morgan & Co.
